commands.description: Replace the sequence caption list with a validated, time-ordered set.
Place library media on a track at a time, linking its camera audio.
Remove one clip or a selection with its linked clips, optionally closing the gap.
Group selected clips so transforms and keyframes apply to them together.
Insert a marked source range at the playhead, rippling later clips right.
Join contiguous parts of one source back into a clip, with their linked parts.
Move a clip to another time and optionally another track, carrying linked clips unless linkedSelectionEnabled is false (defaults to true).
Overwrite the track at the playhead with a marked source range.
Push or pull everything from a clip onward, on every track, by a signed delta.
Point a placed clip and its synchronised linked clips at another library asset.
Move a clip to another index on its track; the track re-flows contiguously.
Move the cut between two adjacent clips without changing the sequence length.
Set clip volume, mute, fades, pitch shift and the clip EQ stage.
Set the clip blend mode and compositing opacity.
Set the crop rectangle and corner-pin quad edited with the preview gizmos.
Set the colour grade: look, intensity, primaries and the three colour wheels.
Set the from and to rectangles of a still clip, or clear the move.
Link or unlink audio and video clips so later edits move them together.
Set or clear the clip mask, including pen path geometry.
Rate-stretch a bounded clip and its linked clips to a new speed.
Set position, scale, rotation and opacity for a clip.
Parent a clip transform to another clip, or clear the pick-whip link.
Add, retime, realign or remove the transition at the cut before a clip.
Slide a clip along the track, trimming its neighbours instead of rippling.
Slip the source range inside a clip without moving the clip.
Split clips at a time, carrying linked clips and Ken Burns geometry across.
Trim a clip out point, optionally rippling the rest of the track.
Trim a clip in point, optionally rippling the rest of the track.
Dissolve a group, leaving its clips in place.
Patch clip fields the narrower commands do not own: name, text, style, position.
Create a compound clip from a selection and place it, openable as its own sequence.
Override published control values on one instance of a composition.
Publish the controls a composition exposes to its instances.
Add a GPU effect to a clip effect stack at an index.
Remove one effect from a clip effect stack.
Reorder the effect stack, which changes the rendered result.
Set the parameters of one effect instance, including LUT and key controls.
Redo the last undone revision, as a server-side revision move.
Undo the last undoable revision; the stack lives with the stored project.
Ask the durable job model to cancel a queued or running job.
Queue AI captioning of media with an explicit destination.
Queue a render of any sequence to an explicit destination.
Queue filler-word detection; the edit itself is applied after review.
Queue frame interpolation for a clip to an explicit destination.
Queue local music generation; the result arrives as an importable asset.
Queue proxy, thumbnail and waveform generation for project media.
Queue a Frameleaf restoration pass with an explicit, never implicit, destination.
Queue a reversed conform of a clip source.
Queue scene detection over project media.
Queue silence detection; the edit itself is applied after review.
Queue a local text-to-speech voiceover; the result arrives as an asset.
Queue on-device transcription; captions land through captions.set.
Queue an upscale pass for a clip to an explicit destination.
Add a keyframe on an animatable property at a time.
Remove keyframes from one property.
Set easing, an explicit bezier or spring parameters on selected keyframes.
Retime or revalue one keyframe from the graph editor or dopesheet, or set its velocity handles and path tangents.
Remap Lottie colours and themes, edit its text and adjust value slots.
Add a marker on the sequence at a time.
Remove a sequence marker.
Rename, recolour or move a sequence marker.
Reference library assets from the project without copying an original.
Relink project media to another asset when the original moved.
Drop unused media references from the project; originals are untouched.
Place a music bed on the music track.
Tell the host the engine no longer needs the frame it last requested.
Ask for one frame of the current revision, rendered at an exact rational time.
Apply a project template, including canvas and frame rate defaults; a rate change on existing content needs timing keep-time or keep-frames.
Export a validated portable project bundle, optionally with copies of the media the person owns.
Import a validated portable project bundle into this project.
Rename the project.
Set the project master bus, which is not the monitor or device volume.
Set editor preferences stored with the project: mode, guides, loop, ducking.
Bake a procedural motion modifier into explicit keyframes.
Set or clear a property expression.
Attach or clear a procedural motion modifier on a property.
Add a timestamped review comment.
Remove a review comment.
Edit or resolve a review comment.
Add a sequence to the project.
Duplicate a sequence, including its tracks and clips.
Remove a sequence; the project keeps at least one.
Switch the active sequence, which is stored on the project.
Set sequence name, caption language and caption burn-in.
Set the sequence canvas and frame rate, including auto-match from first media; a rate change on existing content needs timing keep-time or keep-frames.
Add a shape or a pen path, on a new top layer or a named video track, optionally as a mask.
Set or clear the fill, stroke, geometry and pen-path fields of a shape.
Set per-character, per-word or per-line text animation.
Add a title clip on the title track.
Set or clear single style fields and the styled spans of a title.
Add a track of a kind at an index.
Close the gap at a time on a track, or every gap on it, rippling later clips.
Remove a track and the clips on it.
Reorder tracks, which changes compositing order.
Set track name, mute, lock, solo and gain.
Set the track fader, pan and the track EQ stage.
Place a recorded or generated voiceover on the voice track.
